intro_sentence: Manager-reported metrics for the four private-market funds held in the portfolio, as at Q1 2026 — ECHO as at Q1 2025, the latest reporting available.

funds.name: Themis I
comments: 69.9% of commitments paid in at Q1-26, with a further 5% called in April. Next distribution expected Q3/Q4 2026.
Diversified across 107 cases, 74 still ongoing — competition, commercial, class action and litigation finance in Europe, the US and Australia.
20 wins against 13 losses, ~$19.7m cumulative profit from resolved matters. Still largely in the maturation phase.

funds.name: Left Lane CP II LP 2
comments: 29.6% Gross IRR / 2.0x Gross MOIC; 20.8% Net IRR / 1.6x Net MOIC.
$1.16bn invested across 70 companies, ~$70m dry powder. $27.7m of Q1 follow-ons into 11 existing positions.
DPI still zero; only 39 of 68 unrealised positions above cost. First exits building — Steno secondary at 2.7x, Composer acquired, Rei Do Pitaco pending.

funds.name: ACE Buyout III
comments: 1.9x Gross MOIC on $161.9m invested; $174m distributed against $177m contributed after a 6% distribution in May.
Wide dispersion: Osaic 5.5x, Clarios 4.9x, GFL 2.7x against GoHealth 0.5x and Vesta 0.3x (in forbearance).
Osaic continuation vehicle in process, targeting up to 50% liquidity at the 5.5x mark — the near-term catalyst.

funds.name: ECHO
comments: Two hotels left in the portfolio, in Vienna and Amsterdam. Both will probably sell below NAV.
Full distribution expected in 2026; the fund reaches the end of its term this year.
Awaiting information from the liquidator. Figures are as at Q1 2025, a year older than the other three funds.
